text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, we're back at the academy already!
Time really flies when you're having fun out~."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hm? That is......

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Coming from the school building...
is that Air Groove-san walking over here... maybe?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Could it be they found out
I put a whoopee cushion in the student council room?!
choice_data_list: What kind of harassment is this!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No, it's a good luck charm!
They say if you see it through to the end, it'll give you courage!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Still... if anyone finds out, it'll be awful! They say it turns into terrible luck~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-sa...
No, Almighty Great God Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I place my life in your hands!
Please, I beg of you, take good care of me!
Saying that, Matikane Fukukitaru scrambled headlong to hide in the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Wasn't Fukukitaru
just here a second ago?
choice_data_list: Say you have some errands to run.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see...
In that case, please pass on a message for me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I would like to tell them directly myself,
but unfortunately, I have an urgent meeting right after this and no time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Then, a brief word: I'm grateful... There.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"This morning at the dorm, she thrust a hole puncher into my hands,
claiming it was my lucky item for today."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "To be honest, I took fortunetelling with a grain of salt, but... thanks to it, I was able to prepare for the sudden meeting very efficiently."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...That said, your usual rampages are beyond the pale.
Don't get carried away, and maintain some moderation.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Tell them that.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ugh... *sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Waaah! I'm so happy~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"To have my fortune-telling validated like this...
It feels as though I myself have been validated...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: All of this is surely...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to braving the danger
to set up that whoopee cushion! Absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I don't really get it,
but leave it to me!!

...For now, I headed out immediately afterward
to retrieve the whoopee cushion at the very least.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Right there, you say?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaa!! You traitorrr~~!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what kind of attitude is that?
And after I went out of my way to thank you for this morning, too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A thank-you for this morning??
Could it be about the lucky item?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right.
Thanks to that hole puncher—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that all~?! And here I thought
you found out about the whoopee cushion from last week~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Oho? So that was your doing, was it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Looks like I'll have to pay back that little debt first, huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaah--!! Somebody help me~~!!

I accompanied Matikanefukukitaru,
and received thanks alongside her...
